mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Ethena x Steakhouse USDC (ethenaUSDC) at base:0xbeeff0be997cca5b1c13a7433c2004637975739e is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0x8c47e3c9a99b819222e37b91635bb9fed29c5319 holds 3 enumerated Morpho market IDs. This intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent and older Morpho precedent classifications.
